site.title: World Factory
site.description: Immersive experiences for web, mobile and XR.

sections.title: Immersive experiences for web, mobile and XR.
paragraphs: A new dimension for your ideas. Thoughtfully designed digital places that connect people, businesses, and possibility.

sections.title: One foundation. Many possibilities.
paragraphs: Explore the capabilities taking shape at World Factory. The website experience is live; the other exhibits describe future demonstrations.

sections.title: Built around people. Designed for possibility.
paragraphs: An immersive experience begins with a useful website. Essential information stays accessible, on the devices people already use.
One content foundation connects the conventional website, interactive 3D, and XR. Reusable recipes make each experience adaptable without starting over.

sections.title: Let’s imagine what comes next.
paragraphs: Have a place, a story, or an idea worth exploring? Let’s talk about what an immersive experience could make possible.

experiences.title: Immersive Websites
experiences.summary: A website you can step inside. Explore a shared story across accessible web pages, interactive 3D, and XR.
paragraphs: This showcase demonstrates the first reusable ImmersiveWebsiteRecipe: one content source, an accessible website, and a small interactive showroom.
